message:
Now I see the key issue. In `pj_datum_transform`, the `CHECK_RETURN` macro accesses `transient_error[-defn->ctx->last_errno]` without checking if `last_errno < -49`. The `transient_error` array has only 50 elements (indices 0-49).

The key question is: can `last_errno` be set to a value < -49 during `pj_datum_transform`?

Looking at the flow:
1. `pj_geodetic_to_geocentric` - this can set error codes
2. `pj_geocentric_to_wgs84` / `pj_geocentric_from_wgs84` - these don't set errors
3. `pj_geocentric_to_geodetic` - this can set errors
4. `pj_apply_gridshift_2` - this can set errors

Let me check what error codes these functions can set. Let me look at `pj_geodetic_to_geocentric` and `pj_geocentric_to_geodetic`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜
<parameter=command>grep -n "pj_ctx_set_errno\|last_errno" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/proj.4/src/geocent.c | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
